notes: Read all 99 numbered source lines before editing. L1 `import {forwardRef, useId, type HTMLAttributes} from 'react'` -> React + {forwardRef}; useId is no longer needed because the web's aria-labelledby wiring (L43, L60, L91) collapses into a single accessibilityLabel on the Pressable, and HTMLAttributes is DOM-only. L2 `import {cn} from '@/lib/cn'` -> dropped; the Tailwind/cn class merges become StyleSheet + style-array composition (no Tailwind/cn on native).

L4-10 ToggleProps: the L4 `extends Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, 'onChange'>` DOM passthrough is dropped (no underlying <div>); the meaningful members are ported verbatim — label?:string (L5), checked:boolean (L6), onChange:(checked:boolean)=>void (L7), size?:'sm'|'md' (L8) preserved as size?:ToggleSize where ToggleSize=keyof typeof sizes ('sm'|'md'). The L9 className?:string is accepted-but-ignored (_className) for source compat, mirrored by a native `style` override; native-ergonomic props (style, accessibilityLabel, testID, data-testid) are added like the sibling Checkbox port.

L12-15 trackSize map (sm h-5 w-9, md h-6 w-11) -> sizes[*].trackH/trackW dp {sm:20x36, md:24x44}. L17-20 thumbSize (sm h-3.5 w-3.5, md h-5 w-5) -> sizes[*].thumb {sm:14, md:20}. L22-25 thumbTranslate (sm translate-x-4, md translate-x-5) -> sizes[*].translate {sm:16, md:20}. The three Tailwind maps are consolidated into one `sizes` record keyed sm/md preserving every value.

L27-40 the role=switch accessibility doc comment is ported/adapted into the file header (real <button> Space/Enter -> Pressable accessibilityRole='switch'; aria-labelledby label association -> accessibilityLabel; the neutral wrapper <div> + label-click delegation -> a single Pressable; aria-checked -> accessibilityState.checked).

L41-43 `forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, ToggleProps>(({label, checked, onChange, size='md', className, ...props}, ref) => { const labelId = useId();` -> `forwardRef<View, ToggleProps>` with the same destructured names (label, checked, onChange, size='md') + className renamed _className; useId/labelId removed (no aria-labelledby on native). `dims = sizes[size]` resolves the active size.

L44-55 the outer wrapper `<div className='inline-flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer select-none' onClick={...closest('button')...onChange(!checked)} {...props}>` -> the single accessible <Pressable onPress={() => onChange(!checked)} style={[styles.row, style]}>. styles.row reproduces inline-flex items-center gap-2 (flexDirection row, alignItems center, gap 8); select-none/cursor-pointer have no RN analog. The L48-53 button-vs-label click-delegation (ignore taps that hit the button so it isn't double-fired) is unnecessary because the wrapper and button collapse into one Pressable, so a tap anywhere toggles exactly once — preserving 'clicking the label text toggles'. hitSlop=8 enlarges the touch target.

L56-76 the inner `<button type='button' role='switch' aria-checked={checked} aria-labelledby={label?labelId:undefined} onClick={()=>onChange(!checked)} className='relative inline-flex shrink-0 rounded-full transition-colors ... trackSize ... bg-cyan-500 dark:bg-cyan-600 / bg-gray-300 dark:bg-gray-600'>` -> the track <View> (accessibilityElementsHidden + importantForAccessibility='no-hide-descendants' so the Pressable is the single a11y node, mirroring the button now being the Pressable). styles.track = relative + shrink-0; width/height/borderRadius (rounded-full -> trackH/2) come from dims. The L72-74 checked tint bg-cyan-500 dark:bg-cyan-600 -> TRACK_ON '#0891b2' (cyan-600, dark theme) and bg-gray-300 dark:bg-gray-600 -> TRACK_OFF '#4b5563' (gray-600, dark theme); light-mode values cyan-500 #06b6d4 / gray-300 #d1d5db recorded here. L64 focus-visible:ring* and L70/L82 forced-colors:border-[ButtonBorder] high-contrast borders have no RN analog and are dropped (native focus is platform-driven). transition-colors/transition-transform duration-normal (L63,L79) is visual-only; the native port flips tint/position instantly (no Animated timers) to stay deterministic under --detectOpenHandles, like the Checkbox port.

L77-88 the thumb `<span className='pointer-events-none inline-block rounded-full bg-white shadow-sm transition-transform ... thumbSize ... translate-y-[3px] translate-x-[3px] {checked && thumbTranslate}' aria-hidden>` -> the thumb <View>. styles.thumb = position absolute (pointer-events-none + the web's transform-based offset) + bg-white THUMB_COLOR '#ffffff' + shadow-sm (shadowOffset/Opacity/Radius + elevation). width/height/borderRadius (rounded-full -> thumb/2) from dims; the L84 translate-y-[3px]/translate-x-[3px] base inset -> THUMB_INSET=3 (top:3, left:3), and the L85 `checked && thumbTranslate[size]` -> left = 3 + (checked ? dims.translate : 0), so the knob slides 16px (sm) / 20px (md) right when on. aria-hidden -> the View is excluded from the a11y tree via the parent track's accessibilityElementsHidden.

L90-94 `{label && {label}}` -> `{label ? {label} : null}`. styles.label = text-sm (fontSize 14), font-medium (fontWeight '500'), dark:text-[var(--text-secondary)] -> colors.textSecondary (light-mode text-gray-700 #374151 recorded here); the id/aria-labelledby link is replaced by the Pressable's accessibilityLabel (resolvedAccessibilityLabel = accessibilityLabel ?? label).

L95-99 closing + the forwardRef arrow/closing + `Toggle.displayName='Toggle'` -> Pressable/track/thumb close, the forwardRef close, and `Toggle.displayName='Toggle'` preserved verbatim; a `export default Toggle` was added for native import ergonomics (matching Checkbox/MaskedValue).

Verified NO DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements (div/button/span), lucide-react, Recharts, Leaflet, cn/Tailwind, or old web ui components are imported — only react-native primitives (Pressable, StyleSheet, View) plus the existing shared native AppText and theme `colors`. State/API are unchanged: the component stays fully controlled (checked owned by caller, onChange(!checked) reports the flip), label/size semantics and the sm/md geometry are preserved. A focused parity test (__tests__/ToggleParity.test.tsx) asserts switch role + checked state, on/off track tint, thumb offset, label rendering, and that onPress reports the flipped boolean. Gates run from apps/native: npm run typecheck; npm run lint -- --quiet; npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles.
